Search the current catalog by text, labels and state.

Panel: [Catalog](/docs/reference/cli/panels/catalog/).

## Usage

```text
huron search [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option          | Type | Default | Description                                                        |
| --------------- | ---- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--query`, `-q` | str  |         | Search for this text.                                              |
| `--label`, `-l` | str  |         | A label, as `key=value`. Repeatable.                               |
| `--state`       | str  |         | A collection state: `draft`, `active` or `incomplete`. Repeatable. |
